step_description: Identified bacterial strains via 16S rRNA gene sequencing and analysis
Performed demultiplexing, quality control, and adapter trimming of Illumina sequencing reads
Assembled paired-end Illumina reads into draft genomes using Unicycler
Assessed genome completeness and contamination using CheckM
Annotated prokaryotic genomes using NCBI Prokaryotic Genome Annotation Pipeline
Performed digital DNA-DNA hybridization analysis and species identification using TYGS
Calculated average nucleotide identity to compare genomes and assess species relatedness
